oldClaimsThatMustChange: WHO 2020-03-29 简报只在产生气溶胶的特定医疗程序和场景中承认 COVID-19 空气传播可能性。
newClaims: 7 月简报称，在拥挤、通风不足且与感染者长时间共处的特定室内地点，短距离气溶胶传播不能被排除。
WHO 2024 术语框架把 through the air 作为病原体在空气中旅行或悬浮的一般描述。
2024 框架把 direct deposition 与吸入并列为 through the air transmission 下的另一描述。
forbiddenAfterT1: 不得把 3 月的医疗程序限定继续写成整个演化期唯一范围
不得把 2024 术语框架写成传播占比结论

chronologyEvidence.exactQuote: In the context of COVID-19, airborne transmission may be possible in specific circumstances and settings in which procedures or support treatments that generate aerosols are performed; i.e., endotracheal intubation, bronchoscopy, open suctioning, administration of nebulized treatment, manual ventilation before intubation, turning the patient to the prone position, disconnecting the patient from the ventilator, non-invasive positive-pressure ventilation, tracheostomy, and cardiopulmonary resuscitation.

Short-range aerosol transmission, particularly in specific indoor locations, such as crowded and inadequately ventilated spaces over a prolonged period of time with infected persons cannot be ruled out.

The descriptor ‘through the air’ can be used in a general way to characterize an infectious disease where the main mode of transmission involves the pathogen travelling through the air or being suspended in the air. Under the umbrella of ‘through the air transmission’, two descriptors can be used:
2. Direct deposition, for cases when IRPs are expelled into the air from an infectious person, and are then directly deposited on the exposed mouth, nose or eyes of another person nearby.

oldClaimsThatMustChange: Nature 报道一组学生研究者从被火山掩埋的炭化纸卷中揭示了希腊文内容。
Vesuvius Challenge 于 2023 年 3 月启动，大奖目标是从一份纸卷恢复四段各 140 个字符的文本。
newClaims: 项目官网称 PHerc. 1667 在 2026 年成为首份被虚拟展开并从头到尾读完的赫库兰尼姆纸卷。
项目在该里程碑后把下一阶段设为阅读多份完整纸卷。
forbiddenAfterT1: 不得再把 passages 说成项目最新最高里程碑
不得把一卷扩成所有纸卷

chronologyEvidence.exactQuote: A team of student researchers has made a giant contribution to solving one of the biggest mysteries in archaeology by revealing the content of Greek writing inside a charred scroll buried 2,000 years ago by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius.
Vesuvius Challenge launched in March 2023 with a Grand Prize for the first team to recover four passages of 140 characters from a Herculaneum scroll.
In 2026, PHerc. 1667 became the first Herculaneum scroll to be virtually unwrapped and read end to end.
The challenge now moves onto its next stage: reading multiple entire scrolls.

oldClaimsThatMustChange: WCAG 2.1 的 4.1.1 Parsing 是 Level A 成功标准。
newClaims: WCAG 2.2 声明向后兼容 2.1，但移除了 4.1.1 Parsing。
即使采用 WCAG 2.2，受政策约束必须符合 2.0 或 2.1 的作者仍可能需要测试和报告 4.1.1。
WCAG 2.2 新增九项成功标准，其中 2.5.7 Dragging Movements 为 AA。
forbiddenAfterT1: 不得在 WCAG 2.2-only 范围继续把 4.1.1 当现行标准
不得在旧政策范围无条件停止报告 4.1.1

chronologyEvidence.exactQuote: WCAG 2.2 builds on and is backwards compatible with WCAG 2.1, meaning web pages that conform to WCAG 2.2 are at least as accessible as pages that conform to WCAG 2.1. Requirements have been added that build on 2.1 and 2.0. WCAG 2.2 has removed one success criterion, 4.1.1 Parsing.
Authors that are required by policy to conform with WCAG 2.0 or 2.1 will be able to update content to WCAG 2.2, but may need to continue to test and report 4.1.1.

The following success criteria are new in WCAG 2.2:

- 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) (AA)
- 2.4.12 Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced) (AAA)
- 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA)
- 2.5.7 Dragging Movements (AA)
- 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (AA)
- 3.2.6 Consistent Help (A)
- 3.3.7 Redundant Entry (A)
- 3.3.8 Accessible Authentication (Minimum) (AA)
- 3.3.9 Accessible Authentication (Enhanced) (AAA)
